title: Virtual Compute: immediate refund — current authority
content:
## Calculation basis

Virtual Compute immediate refund — The authorized refund is the smaller of the currently recomputed permitted amount and the approved assessment amount, so neither a stale assessment nor a changed current balance increases authority.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for immediate refund — current authority?**

The authorized refund is the smaller of the currently recomputed permitted amount and the approved assessment amount, so neither a stale assessment nor a changed current balance increases authority.

## Hypothetical case

Hypothetically, the recomputed permitted amount is 80 USD and the approved assessment is 65 USD: authority is limited to 65 USD. If the current permitted amount instead falls to 50 USD, the same assessment authorizes no more than 50 USD. If the assessment is 90 USD while current permission is 80 USD, authority is 80 USD.
